source_title: Guidance for inspection of atmospheric refrigerated ammonia storage tanks (2008 ed., issue 2014)
value_or_rule_read: Survey of 22 tanks: virtually all have secondary containment, over 80% full-height concrete or steel wall. Listed types: tank with full-height bund holding full contents with impervious floor and roof cover; tank-in-tank; partial bund; earth dyke; single wall. Rollover/mixing of aqueous and anhydrous layers can exceed PSV capacity and lift the shell; preferable weak roof-to-shell weld on new tanks. Commissioning: N2 purge to O2 below 4%, later step below 0.5% before NH3. Detectors test every 6 months, bund visual check yearly.
